cards.d: The element for muzzle shows a vase fixed over a mouth, perhaps with a rubber band running around the back of the head to keep it in place.
Picture a clam used as a muzzle to quiet the complaints of a fisherman’s widow asking compensation for her husband lost at sea.
cards.e: 賠償 배상 compensation, indemnity

cards.d: 'To muzzle the soil' means to put the soil under a green-house serving it as a respirator, this is a way of cultivating a good amount of vegetables.
cards.e: 栽培 재배 cultivation, raising, growing

cards.d: To “divide and conquer” you use a saber and a muzzle.
cards.e: 剖檢 부검 autopsy, postmorted examination

cards.d: The kanji for sound depicts something standing in the air over a tongue wagging in a mouth, much the same as a sound does for the briefest of moments before disappearing.
cards.e: 乻音 얼음 ice; 音樂 음악 music

cards.d: When “darkness covered the earth” at the beginning of time, there was neither sun nor sound.
cards.e: 暗記 암기 memorization; 暗黑 암흑 darkness, blackness

cards.d: Poetry restricted to verses that rhyme often finds it has to abandon clarity of thought in order to make the rhyme of the words work. In this kanji’s picture, one becomes a kind of “sound-employee.”
cards.e: 餘韻 여운 lingering feeling; 韻文 운문 verse, poem, poetry

cards.d: It pictures the sound of a fiesta, namely a kazoo.
A person of discriminating intellect can tell the difference between mere kazoo-buzzing and words spoken wisely.
cards.e: 常識 상식 common sense; 知識 지식 knowledge, acquaintaince

cards.d: This kanji shows a pair of human legs and a tongue-wagging mouth looking at a mirror standing on the wall, asking perhaps who might be the fairest of them all.
cards.e: 畢竟 필경 after all, finally

cards.d: After lakes but before glass, polished metal was used for mirrors. These metal mirrors are recalled in this character for a mirror.
cards.e: 眼鏡 안경 glasses, spectacles

cards.d: Imagine the boundary of a plot of land marked with gigantic mirrors enabling the landowner to keep trespassers in sight at all times.
cards.e: 境遇 경우 case, circumstance; 地境 지경 boundary, border

cards.d: A top hat hanging on a hook in the front hall, right where the deceased left it the day he died, reminds us of him and his kanji.
cards.e: 逃亡 도망 escape, flight; 死亡 사망 death, decease

cards.d: If one’s eyes perish before death, one remains blind for the rest of life.
cards.e: 盲目 맹목 blindness; 盲人 맹인 blind person

cards.d: The “ideal woman” one daydreams about is no more than a delusion. Hence, perish the thought of her.
cards.e: 虛妄 허망 futility; 妄言 망언 reckless remark, thoughtless words

cards.d: The flowers that perish in the flood are taken here as symbols of an area that has been laid waste.
cards.e: 荒唐하다 황당하다 absurd; 荒野 황야 wilderness, waste, wasteland

cards.d: The story of ambition talks of a king walking under the perishing (or “waning”) moon dreaming great dreams about his kingdom. (The roots of ambition are from the same word as “ambulate,” meaning to walk about.)
cards.e: 希望 희망 hope, wish, aspiration

cards.d: Spinning a dagger about on its hilt on the top of a top hat waiting to see in which direction it points when it comes to rest — one leaves to fate where one is going next.
cards.e: 今方 금방 just now, soon; 方向 방향 direction

cards.d: Imagine a compass that is disturbed every time a woman passes by, sending the needle spinning madly round and round.
cards.e: 妨害 방해 disturbance, obstruction, interference

cards.d: The character for a boy shows us a Boy Scout cleaning the dirt out of his compass — the more dirt, the better.
cards.e: 洞네坊네 동네방네 all over the neighborhood; 坊坊曲曲 방방곡곡 everywhere

cards.d: Here we see a special compass used to pick out those flowers most suited for making good perfumes.
cards.e: 芳年 방년 sweet age

cards.d: One who eats too much soon needs a compass to find one’s way around the obese mass of flesh that accumulates in the midsection.
cards.e: 脂肪 지방 fat, grease

cards.d: When making a courtesy call on a dignitary, one has to gauge one’s words with great care. Hence the need for a compass.
cards.e: 訪問 방문 call, visit, interview

cards.d: The taskmaster sets an unruly servant free, giving him no more than a quick glance at the compass and a boot from behind.
cards.e: 放送 방송 broadcasting; 開放 개방 opening

cards.d: Some cosmic taskmaster hovering overhead whips up the waves to make them dash violently against the shore. In the white foam that covers the water we see a broken compass floating, all that remains of a shipwreck.
cards.e: 激勵 격려 encouragement; 激하다 격하다 (get) excited, (be) enraged, become violent

cards.d: The two horns on the head of the teenager are enough to suggest to most parents of adolescents a good image of a devil.
cards.e: 兌換 태환 conversion

cards.d: To undress is to expose the flesh and tempt the devil in the eyes of one’s onlookers. Ignore the moral if you want, but not the devil.
cards.e: 脫出 탈출 escape; 脫色 탈색 decoloration, decolorization

cards.d: Not inappropriately, this character likens a rumor to the devil’s own words.
cards.e: 說明 설명 explanation; 說話 설화 tale, story, fable; 說得 설득 persuasion

cards.d: Metal that has been pointed (as an awl, a pick, a nail, or a knife) tends to serve the devil’s purposes as well as civilization’s: our tools are also our weapons.
cards.e: 銳利하다 예리하다 sharp, keen; 銳敏하다 예민하다 sharp, keen, acute, fine

cards.d: This primitive is composed of a pair of horns growing out of a brain with a tongue wagging in the mouth beneath. Think of “former” in connection with administrators or heads of state who have just left office but continue to make a nuisance of themselves by advertising their opinions on public policy.
cards.e: 曾孫 증손 great-grandchild;  曾祖 증조 great-grandfather

cards.d: This kanji depicts an increase of soil, multiplying so fast that it literally buries everything in its path.
cards.e: 急增 급증 sudden increase; 增加 증가 increase

cards.d: The presents offered here are money that increases each time you give it away.
cards.e: 寄贈 기증 contribution, donation, presentation

cards.d: As a “Western” language, English identifies the east with the rising sun. In more fanciful terms, we see the sun piercing through a tree as it rises in the east.
cards.e: 東쪽 동쪽 east; 東洋 동양 the Orient, the East

cards.d: If the piece of wood in the roof known as the ridgepole points east, the sunrise will be visible from the front door.
cards.e: 病棟 병동 hospital ward; 別棟 별동 a house/building separate/detached from the main building; an outbuilding

cards.d: The whole secret to breaking the ice with the East is to peek behind those mysteriously “frozen smiles.”
cards.e: 冷凍 냉동 freezing, refrigeration

cards.d: Let the extended dot at the top represent the load that the samurai is carrying in his role as the master’s porter.
A woman who is in her pregnancy is a bit like a porter, bearing her new companion wherever she goes.
cards.e: 妊娠 임신 pregrancy

cards.d: Those who rule the courts, the porters of justice and order, are often found to stretch the law to suit their own purposes.
cards.e: 法廷 법정 (law) court, judgement hall
